Route: a `sys_*` object, not a settings key — the same-concept precedent is `sys_unit.decimal_places` (`packages/platform-objects/src/**/sys-unit.object.ts`: 0..12, field history, `member_default` read, `organization_admin` write); `localization.currency` (ADR-0144 D4) is an org-wide scalar read through a projection, so it does not fit a per-code value. Readings: the thread's A1–A4 at 98bda0ac.
Shape: `sys_standard_unit_setting` (`code` select over `STANDARD_UNITS`, unique per org, immutable; `decimal_places` 0..12 optional, `trackHistory`; clear = null; no delete). Grants: `organization_admin` create/edit, `member_default` read; external members no read (as `sys_unit`).
Reader: not in this PR. Zero callers today; #35490 adds the reader with its first caller, and the L4 clamp lives there. This card's "a member can read them" is met by the object's read grant over the data API.
File surface (adds to the claim's line): `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`, `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`, generated translations via their generators only. ⛔ `packages/objectql/**` dropped from this card.

Claim amendment to comment 7178077326 (area o5-D) · 2026-11-25T23:51Z
Shape correction: clear = the organization admin deletes the row (`organization_admin` create/edit/delete; `member_default` read only); `decimal_places` is required, so a row exists only while an override is set. Reason (thread reading): a non-deletable organization-owned row would block organization delete (plugin-auth refuses while any organization-owned row remains, `auth-manager-before-hook.ts` ~492 `DELETE_RESTRICTED`); only `sys_unit` is exempt through the objectql cascade, which is off this card's surface. Posture follows `sys_exchange_rate`; create/edit/delete audited through plugin-audit's `sys_audit_log`, asserted by the card's tests. Supersedes "clear = null; no delete" in 7178077326.
